user.title: Set up Gramps HA
user.description: Connect to your Gramps Web instance

data_description.url: Base URL of your Gramps Web instance, e.g. https://gramps.example.com
data_description.username: A Gramps Web user. A read-only account with the Member role is enough.
data_description.password: Password of that Gramps Web user.
data_description.num_birthdays: How many upcoming birthdays get their own set of sensors.
data_description.show_deathdays: Also create sensors for upcoming death anniversaries.
data_description.show_anniversaries: Also create sensors for upcoming wedding anniversaries.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch new data from Gramps Web. Default: 168 (once a week).

abort.already_configured: This Gramps Web instance is already configured
